headline: Volleyball | King City and Soledad suffer losses to division leaders
summary: SALINAS VALLEY — The King City and Soledad high school volleyball teams fell to division-leading Robert Louis Stevenson and second-place Alisal, respectively, last week on the same day to drop into a third-place tie with 4-2 records.
